summary: The owner asked to automate placing a room on the ship. The client can only upgrade existing rooms; nothing buys and places one, and the request shape is unknown. SPEC-13 is a draft for the owner to approve: - owner-supplied sanitized captures first (new gate G6); - a pure placement check that refuses on any unobserved grid, size, position or price; - a non-idempotent place_room action verified only from a later ship read; - an account-wide block after an unknown placement; - an explicit one-off --mode place, authorized per account and position, never from   a policy, so baseline-v1 and the SPEC-07 trial are unchanged; - one live placement, with the workflow step owner-only. An agent review found no blockers; its findings (data provenance, the no-retry scope, AC3 versus the runner, contradicted scope, precondition inputs, baseline format, authorization and mode wiring, plan-only scope, the secret-holding workflow, trial interventions) are folded in. Added to the spec plan as Draft.  test_real_specs_parse now expects S01 to S13.

proof: code names cited by the spec checked with grep (baseline _ROOM_KEYS, sdk/ship_layout.py, RoomDesignPurchases, RUN_MODES, EXECUTE_MODES)
scripts/spec_trace.py, make syntax-check, make test and git diff --check pass
